# scheduler API

Schedules, their runs, rain pause and the weather.

Base path `/api/v1/scheduler` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/scheduler.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/scheduler.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### schedules

#### GET /api/v1/scheduler/mowers/{mower_id}/angles

**Mower Angles**

Where the mowing angle rotation of a mower stands (ADR 0061): the last angle per area (from scheduled runs and manual starts with rotation chosen) and the step the start sheet offers for manual starts. `can_view` on the mower.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerAnglesOut](#moweranglesout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/scheduler/mowers/{mower_id}/angles

**Record Manual Angle**

A manual start with rotation chosen sent `angle_deg` for `area_ids`: the next run of these areas continues from it. A start with an explicit angle is not reported. `can_control` on the mower.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [ManualAngleIn](#manualanglein)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerAnglesOut](#moweranglesout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### PUT /api/v1/scheduler/mowers/{mower_id}/angles/settings

**Set Rotation Settings**

Set the rotation step of manual starts (null: off). `can_control` on the mower.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [RotationSettingsIn](#rotationsettingsin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerAnglesOut](#moweranglesout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/scheduler/mowers/{mower_id}/widget

**Widget**

What the iOS schedule and weather widgets show for one mower (ADR 0059): the next runs (at most 3), the verdict of the rain pause for now (`runs`, `rain_pause`, `unsure`) and a few rain facts. `can_view` on the mower; schedules the caller may not see are left out.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [WidgetScheduleOut](#widgetscheduleout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/scheduler/schedules

**List Schedules**

Schedules of the caller's account whose target (mower or group) the caller may view.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ScheduleList](#schedulelist) |

#### POST /api/v1/scheduler/schedules

**Create Schedule**

A new schedule: `can_edit_schedule` and `can_control` on the target (403 when the target is visible, 404 otherwise, also for a target of another account). The caller becomes the owner; every firing re-checks the owner's `can_control`.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [ScheduleIn](#schedulein)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ScheduleOut](#scheduleout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### ObstacleDetection

How eagerly the mower avoids obstacles during a native job (`MowPattern`).

Which modes a mower offers depends on its model and firmware (`MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_detection`). The names follow the vendor apps: `off` is the plain bump-and-turn behaviour, `standard` avoids obstacles it sees ahead, `sensitive` additionally avoids areas that are not lawn; `slow_touch` and `less_touch` exist only on older firmware.

Type: `"off"` \| `"slow_touch"` \| `"less_touch"` \| `"standard"` \| `"sensitive"`

### PathOrder

Whether the border laps run before or after the fill of a native job.

Type: `"border_first"` \| `"grid_first"`

### ScheduleIn

`POST /schedules`.

`kind=weekly` needs `days_of_week`; `kind=every_n_days` needs `anchor_date` (the first day it fires) and `interval_days`; `kind=once` needs `anchor_date` (the day of its one run, which must lie in the future with `start_time`). `start_time` is wall-clock time in the schedule's time zone (the target's site, or `timezone`). `area_ids` empty means every area of the mower's map; a group target always mows every area of each mower.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `anchor_date` | string (date) or null | no |  |
| `area_ids` | array of string | no | max items 50 |
| `blade_height_mm` | integer or null | no | Blade height in millimetres sent before each start (`set_blade_height`); null keeps the mower's own. Must lie within every target mower's `blade_height_range_mm`. |
| `days_of_week` | array of `"mon"` \| `"tue"` \| `"wed"` \| `"thu"` \| `"fri"` \| `"sat"` \| `"sun"` | no | max items 7 |
| `duration_minutes` | integer | no | The window: no start after it closed.; min 1.0; max 1440.0; default `120` |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | default `true` |
| `interval_days` | integer or null | no |  |
| `kind` | `"weekly"` \| `"every_n_days"` \| `"once"` | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 100 |
| `pattern` | [SchedulePatternIn](#schedulepatternin) or null | no | Start settings of every run (`SchedulePattern`), laid over the mower's mow defaults. Settings beyond the angle and the border laps must be offered by every mower of the target (422 otherwise). |
| `pause_running_jobs_on_rain` | boolean | no | Send a running scheduled job back to the dock when it rains.; default `true` |
| `rain_pause` | [RainPause](#rainpause) | no |  |
| `return_to_dock_at_window_end` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `rotation_angles` | array of number | no | Angles used round robin, one per run (replace `pattern.angle_deg`).; max items 24 |
| `rotation_step_deg` | number or null | no | Step rotation (ADR 0061): each run turns the last angle the mower mowed its areas with by this many degrees (modulo 180); null: off. Excludes `rotation_angles`. |
| `speed_mps` | number or null | no | Mowing speed in m/s sent before each start (`set_speed`); null keeps the mower's own. Must lie within every target mower's speed range. |
| `start_time` | string (time) | yes |  |
| `target_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `target_type` | `"mower"` \| `"group"` | yes |  |
| `timezone` | string or null | no | IANA name overriding the site's time zone. |

### SchedulePattern

The start settings one schedule sets for each of its runs (ADR 0024 amendment of 2026-10-24): the keys of :class:`MowPattern` that make sense for a recurring job, each optional. A key left out (None) is not part of the schedule: the run takes it from the mower's mow defaults in Fleet, and without those the mower keeps its own setting (for the pattern, angle and border laps the clients' fallback, stripes at 0 degrees with one lap).

`start_progress_pct` is not offered: it skips the first part of one job's route, which only makes sense to resume an interrupted job, never for every run of a schedule.

Which values fit one mower is decided with its :class:`MowerCapabilities` (:meth:`problem`); a group schedule must fit every mower of the group.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angle_deg` | number or null | no | Base angle in degrees; null: the mow defaults'. A schedule's `rotation_angles` replace it run by run; with `rotation_step_deg` it is the angle of the first run, later runs turn the last angle by the step (ADR 0061). |
| `border_laps` | integer or null | no |  |
| `name` | `"stripes"` \| `"diagonal"` \| `"checkerboard"` \| `"edge_only"` \| `"random_angle"` or null | no | The native pattern; null: the mow defaults'. |
| `obstacle_detection` | [ObstacleDetection](#obstacledetection) or null | no | Needs the mode in `start_options.obstacle_detection`. |
| `obstacle_laps` | integer or null | no | Needs `start_options.obstacle_laps_range`. |
| `order` | [PathOrder](#pathorder) or null | no | Needs the order in `orders`. |
| `spacing_m` | number or null | no | Path spacing in metres; needs `MowerCapabilities.path_spacing_range_mm`. |

### SchedulePatternIn

The start settings of a schedule (`SchedulePattern`): every key optional, null or left out falls back to the mower's mow defaults, then to the mower's own setting. Unknown keys, including `start_progress_pct`, are refused.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angle_deg` | number or null | no | Base angle in degrees; null: the mow defaults'. A schedule's `rotation_angles` replace it run by run; with `rotation_step_deg` it is the angle of the first run, later runs turn the last angle by the step (ADR 0061). |
| `border_laps` | integer or null | no |  |
| `name` | `"stripes"` \| `"diagonal"` \| `"checkerboard"` \| `"edge_only"` \| `"random_angle"` or null | no | The native pattern; null: the mow defaults'. |
| `obstacle_detection` | [ObstacleDetection](#obstacledetection) or null | no | Needs the mode in `start_options.obstacle_detection`. |
| `obstacle_laps` | integer or null | no | Needs `start_options.obstacle_laps_range`. |
| `order` | [PathOrder](#pathorder) or null | no | Needs the order in `orders`. |
| `spacing_m` | number or null | no | Path spacing in metres; needs `MowerCapabilities.path_spacing_range_mm`. |

### ScheduleRunOutcome

What one run of a schedule did for one mower.

Type: `"started"` \| `"skipped_rain"` \| `"skipped_permission"` \| `"skipped_window"` \| `"skipped_mower_busy"` \| `"skipped_manual"` \| `"failed"`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |

| `ctx` | object | no |  |
| `input` | any | no |  |
| `loc` | array of string or integer | yes |  |
| `msg` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string | yes |  |

### WeatherOut

| `at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `decision` | [RainDecisionOut](#raindecisionout) | yes |  |
| `mower_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

### WidgetRain

Rain facts for the widgets (everything null when no forecast is available).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expected_mm_next_hours` | number or null | yes | Precipitation of the coming hours the rain pause looks at (its look-ahead). |
| `pause_until` | string (date-time) or null | yes | When a rain pause ends, if one holds. |
| `raining_now` | boolean or null | yes | The forecast hour that contains `at` has measurable precipitation. |
| `recent_mm_6h` | number or null | yes |  |
| `wet` | boolean | yes | The lawn is still wet from earlier rain. |
| `wet_until` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |

One upcoming run in the widget overview.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration_minutes` | integer | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `schedule_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

### WidgetScheduleOut

`GET /mowers/{mower_id}/widget`: what the schedule and weather widgets of the iOS app show for one mower (ADR 0059).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `mower_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `rain` | [WidgetRain](#widgetrain) | yes |  |
| `runs` | array of [WidgetRunOut](#widgetrunout) | yes | The next runs, soonest first (at most 3). |
| `verdict` | `"runs"` \| `"rain_pause"` \| `"unsure"` | yes | `runs`: the next run would start; `rain_pause`: the rain pause holds it; `unsure`: no forecast or no location, or the forecast is unknown. |
